name: Palavra
tagline: editor-video-ia's face-first recipe: one word at a time at 104 px, a cream emphasis word, zoom alternating 1.0 / 1.12.

motion.direction: editor-video-ia « rosto e ideia ». One word at a time: Jost 800 at 104 px, white with a soft shadow, the emphasis word scaled and cream `gold`; commas kept, periods stripped; a 0.3 s clean pause at the end of each sentence. Zoom alternates 1.0 / 1.12 per cut with a slow creep; a screen every 4–8 s (`card` with an `imageCard`, a tweet-style `lockCard`, a `counter`, `chips`); 1–2 s dark / light "breaths" with one big phrase on `mar`. Fraunces 600 for titles, orange `ter` as the brand accent, blue `goldd` second; `cru` finish: warm soft-light tint, 7 % grain, vignette, taped tilted images. Never two animations at once; never eat a word.
